thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-prod (high error rate). Incident ID: INC-2026-8472. Trigger: 5xx spike on /v1/generate.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty notification sent to rotation: ops-oncall (Maya). Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager.
Maya: on it, looking at dashboards now.
Maya: noticing a small window of 504s from tf-serving pool-3, CPU spiking on host-gpu-07.
Maya: acked INC-2026-8472 via mobile.
PagerDuty: ACK received from Maya at 3345678928.
IncidentBot: auto-note: ack logged but no runbook started within 2m.
Maya: I'm SSHing into host-gpu-07, grabbing logs.
Sam: ping — are we customer-facing errors or internal retries? dashboards ixn?
Maya: customer-facing 5xx for streaming requests, mostly long sequence cases. Adding reroute to fallback region for 10% of traffic.
PagerDuty: Escalation triggered: primary did not confirm remediation in escalation window; paging secondary (Liam).
Liam: I got a page, jumping in. saw Maya already acked.
Liam: can you post the live tail of the worker logs?
Maya: paste \n```
2026-03-14T21:01:13Z worker[gpu-07] ERROR kvcache miss seq=2048 latency=1200ms ret=502
2026-03-14T21:01:18Z worker[gpu-07] WARN oom fallback triggered
2026-03-14T21:01:19Z worker[gpu-07] ERROR HttpHandler 502 write: broken pipe
```
Maya: looks like repeated OOM-ish behavior during long seq generation.
Liam: acking to take lead for mitigation.
PagerDuty: ACK received from Liam at 3345678959.
Jess: I just got manager escalation page as well. Was that expected? I wasn't primary on the rotation.
Sam: same — we got a manager page as well. looks like escalation policy fired to manager after secondary ack timeout?
IncidentBot: PagerDuty audit: primary ack at 3345678928, secondary ack at 3345678959. Manager escalation rule TTL=180s started at 3345678928. Manual override by rotation owner may suppress manager page, but no suppress seen.
Jess: weird — I clicked the manager page and it says both "escalation triggered" and a separate "manual page" that looks like a duplicate.
Maya: I did not manually page manager. I only routed 10% traffic and was SSHing.
Liam: I did a manual silence for the escalation policy to stop further pages — did that maybe fire a manager notify? I used the PD web UI "suppress" but a confirm-pop suggested also to notify manager?
PagerDuty: Audit log entry: user=Liam action=suppress_incident details="Suppressed incident; notifyOverride=true" at 3345678968.
Sam: ah ok — that notifyOverride flag is the culprit. It triggers manager notify if set. Looks like the PD UI defaulted to notify manager when suppressing.
Jess: so I'm seeing duplicate manager pages: one from the escalation policy (because manager TTL expired while actions were happening) and one from the manual suppress with notify=true.
Maya: customers still seeing errors but rate dropped from 6%->2% after adding reroute.
Liam: mitigation plan: 1) spin up an extra gpu pool instance to absorb long sequences, 2) extend autoscaler min by +2, 3) temporary guardrails to reject >6k tokens, 4) continue traffic reroute.
Sam: agree. Liam, can you run the scale-up and make the autoscaler change?
Liam: doing now. running infra change: \n```
# scale pool
infractl scale --pool inference-pool-3 --add 2
# bump autoscaler
infractl autoscaler update --pool inference-pool-3 --min-instances 6
```
Liam: scaled nodes requested, new nodes will join in ~45s.
IncidentBot: node provisioning events: node-307 joining at 3345679010, node-308 joining at 3345679024.
Maya: tail shows drop in 5xx after node join, rate back to normal within 90s of nodes ready.
Jess: thanks for the quick mitigation. Two follow-ups: (1) why did PD notify manager twice, (2) can we avoid the PD UI default that notifies manager on suppress?
PagerDuty: System note: duplicate manager notifications observed due to overlap of escalation policy firing and manual suppression with notifyOverride=true. Recommend updating suppression workflow or defaulting to no manager notify.
Sam: tagging infra and PD config owners for follow-up.
Maya: short customer impact note: ~4k requests affected over 8 minutes, mostly streaming long sequences, error rate peak 6.2%. No SLA breach expected, but flagged.
Liam: action items taking to postmortem: - verify autoscaler min change and rollback threshold - add guardrail to detect long-seq OOM pattern and preemptively reject - update runbook to include \"do not use notify override when suppressing unless escalating to manager is intended\" - tune PD escalation windows to account for fast manual mitigations.
Jess: I'll own the PD config change. Sam please create incident ticket INC-2026-8472 in JIRA with customer-impact notes and assign to Liam for mitigation details and Maya for logs.
Sam: creating JIRA INC-2026-8472 now. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-8472
IncidentBot: Incident closed by consensus at 3345679215. Final note: mitigation successful, follow-ups assigned. :white_check_mark:
Maya: thanks team. postmortem sync at 10:00 PT tomorrow.
Liam: adding logs and timeline to the ticket.
Jess: leaving manager-level page policy change in my backlog, will update by EOD.
Sam: closing thread. :thumbsup:
